In this role, you will own the analysis of different modalities (proteins, mAbs, AAV, etc.) using PCR, ELISA, and Bioassay techniques.
cond_0251.responsibilities:
Execute laboratory work plan/schedule developed with input from supervisor or senior team member
Lead lab work with the assistance of a senior team member
Drive the writing of methods, certificates of analysis, deviations, and other technical documents
Execute parallel review of laboratory documentation
Perform technical review of documents for accuracy, thoroughness, and regulatory compliance
Train others on procedures and laboratory techniques
Execute efficiency improvement projects with guidance
Identify process improvements and take ownership of implementation
All other duties as assigned
cond_0251.requirements:
Masters degree is required with 0 years of experience OR Bachelors degree is required with 2 or more years of experience OR Associates degree is required with 4 or more years of experience
Familiarity with some lab techniques, including Elisa, Cell Culture, SDS Page Gels, and PCR, is strongly preferred
Must be able to move from task-to-task quickly
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Must be goal-oriented, and be able to work with others toward a common goal
Highly proficient in basic computer usage, and familiarity with lab programs, including Softmax and Hamilton
Must be collaborative, and work well in teams
Quick learner, with a willingness to learn new techniques and grow within the team
Individual may be required to sit, stand, walk regularly and occasionally lift 0-15 pounds
cond_0251.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.
